passes: The scene sustains length through task pressure, file versions, meeting interruptions and competing professional needs rather than narrator explanation.
Ma Qing remains the viewpoint center without becoming morally or intellectually superior to Song Nan.
Song Nan's statistical caution and Ma Qing's delivery pressure both remain legitimate goods.
A third professional perspective changes the conflict: the medical colleague fears premature abandonment while Song Nan fears premature advancement.
Minor inefficiency, wrong-file confusion, coffee, mistaken door opening and schedule changes create dead time and friction without decorative symbolism.
No character gives a life lesson or explains the theme.
The ending remains procedurally unfinished: a new ownership question arrives after the team thought the slide was ready.
Professional competence is visible, but competence does not eliminate irritation, tone mistakes, version errors or ambiguity.
problems: Several lines are still unusually efficient, especially '你今天最怕他们误解成什么' and the product colleague's '一个别砍，一个别推'. These work in a task meeting but should not become a default dialogue rhythm.
The recurring final_v3/version-control motif is vivid and useful, but repeated procedural motifs can become writerly signatures if overused across chapters.

The doctor, product colleague and department head assistant remain functional side roles rather than full guest arcs. That is acceptable for this probe, but any recurring one should receive a guest dossier.
The coffee omission and recycle-bin exchange add lived texture; too many comparable micro-comic beats in one chapter could make realism feel engineered.
The scene is strong in institutional/professional texture and weak in bodily, spatial and relational history beyond the meeting room. A whole novel cannot stay at this density of work scenes.

narrative_voice_candidate.label: close_external_restrained_realism
narrative_voice_candidate.distance: Stay close enough to register selective attention and momentary hesitation, but keep most meaning in speech, action, objects, timing and institutional constraints.
narrative_voice_candidate.interiority_rule: Use brief interior access only when it changes what the viewpoint notices or does. Do not translate every reaction into a named emotion or motive.
narrative_voice_candidate.dialogue_rule: Let trained professionals sometimes communicate efficiently, but preserve interruption, incomplete repair, status effects, tiredness and occasional bad phrasing.
narrative_voice_candidate.scene_end_rule: End when the local action naturally stops or changes task; do not add a retrospective meaning shot.
narrative_voice_candidate.ordinary_detail_rule: Use mundane details when they create friction, timing, status or attention. Do not turn ordinary objects into symbolic props by default.
narrative_voice_candidate.campbell_rule: Hero-journey structure remains backstage. Transformation is inferred across repeated scenes, never announced inside a scene.

next_recommendation: Freeze a provisional narrative-voice specification, then test the same voice outside professional settings: one domestic/private scene, one travel/public-space scene, and one intellectually intense research scene. If the voice remains distinct across all three, chapter architecture can move from provisional to active design.
